entities.summary: Olli-Pekka Kallasvuo is a Finnish businessman who serves the current Chairman of the Board of Cinia Oy, chaired the committee for World Design Capital Helsinki 2012, and is the former chairman, chief executive officer and president of Nokia, as well as a former board member of Nokia Siemens Networks.
